scope: Three-case raw Wan-Animate-2 Hand2Dex seed-42 smoke
summary: All three pinned raw candidates passed motion and target-identity proxies but failed object and temporal gates, yielding 0/3 complete case passes; the frozen fail-fast rule stops seeds 43 and 44.
evidence: Case 1 scored motion 0.807974, identity 0.992787, object 0.211167, and temporal 0.314752.
Case 2 scored motion 0.785458, identity 0.974959, object 0.653830, and temporal 0.246224.
Case 3 scored motion 0.774395, identity 0.987374, object 0.003866, and temporal 0.311885.
Every case passed the frozen motion 0.75 and identity 0.80 gates; every case failed object 0.75 and temporal 0.75.
Mean scores were motion 0.789276, identity 0.985040, object 0.289621, and temporal 0.290953.
The frozen summary decision is stop_raw_wan_animate2_seed_expansion.
lessons: Direct driving solves much of appearance and gross motion transfer but does not preserve manipulated objects or temporal interaction well enough on these cases.
Expanding random seeds after 0/3 all-gates passes would spend compute without addressing the failed mechanism.
The next method change must introduce object/contact factorization or explicit geometry rather than seed search.
limitations: Three public examples remain too small for any SOTA conclusion.
Metrics are deterministic visual proxies and do not establish 3-D contact or robot execution.
Wan-Animate-2 is a general animation baseline, not PhiZero physical-language inference.
next_actions: Keep the raw results as a strong baseline and test an object-factored or geometry-conditioned method on a larger object-disjoint benchmark.
Do not run seeds 43/44 for the unchanged raw Wan-Animate-2 method.
